notes.content:
Bugfix for second boss where some projectiles would go in random, untelegraphed directions.
 Relatedly, changes to second boss where projectiles were now more easily dodgeable.

FPS improvements all around


The sword and fireball upgrade don't live forever anymore, sadly.


Some enemies aren't looking for nonexistent references anymore, also sadly.

Removed upgraded Shuriken firing with Skyshot support each iteration. A bit too powerful it turns out.

Modified the Axe Upgrade to give it more consistent clearing ability.

Fixed an issue where pustules could spawn outside of walking area.

notes.title: 1.0.0a Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed the health and armor of a few enemies.
Sped up the pustule reward scrolling speed.
Fix Spark upgrade with Skyshot support not moving.
Fix for enemies on the second level not moving.

There are reported FPS drops in later parts of levels, working on a fix.
